description: Number of Beds in Government Hospitals by Municipality is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by Ministry of Public Health. This dataset provides information about the number of beds available in government hospitals in the State of Qatar by municipality from 2020 to 2025. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher Ministry of Public Health. Its tags are beds, hospitals. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-09-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support health-facility access and emergency-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
